'Stellenbeschreibung' is responsibilities: DevOps, Cloud-Architekturen and Scrum appear only there and are not labeled. The coding-agent ask in 'Stellenbeschreibung' is repeated in Qualifikationen, so the quotes come from Qualifikationen.
Appetite bullet: 'Interesse daran, ... einzuarbeiten' makes Azure ML, Public Cloud, Data Factory, Synapse and ETL/ELT nice_to_have (rule 3). The raw_text for those labels keeps the appetite phrase, including the source typo 'Dichin'.
Cloud: required, from the unmarked bullet 'Anbindung von Cloud-Umgebungen'. That wins over the appetite mention 'Cloud Technologien'/'Public Cloud'. Flagged uncertain in case the 'Cloud-Umgebungen' bullet is read as purely about networking.
Networking: required, from 'netzwerkseitigen Anbindung'. That wins over the VNets/Private Endpoints mention, which is under the 'von Vorteil' bullet.
'von Vorteil' bullet: the marker ('is an advantage') makes everything in it nice_to_have: Azure, Identity Management/RBAC/ACL and ADLS Gen2. Azure is never asked for as a requirement elsewhere, so it stays nice_to_have.
Azure Storage: not mapped to object-storage, because the posting never names object storage.
Claude Code and Codex: offered as alternatives ('z.B. Claude Code oder Codex'), so they form alternative_group 1. The broad ai-developer-tooling ('Coding Agents', 'AI-assisted Coding') stays out of the group.
Seniority: the posting hires at multiple levels ('Professional, Senior Professional und Principal'), which is treated like 'all levels', so null. Flagged uncertain.
Degree: 'oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation' counts as an equivalent-qualification clause, so degree_or_equivalent is true. 'Studium' with no level maps to bachelor.
